import random, sys, time
sys.path.insert(0,'/app/submit')
import pipeline
random.seed(5)
# worst case: 2048 distinct /128 prefixes
entries=[]
seen=set()
while len(entries)<2048:
    a=random.getrandbits(128)
    if a in seen: continue
    seen.add(a); entries.append((a,128,random.randrange(65536)))
fib=[{'prefix':pipeline.canonical_prefix(a,l),'hop':h} for a,l,h in entries]
req={'op':'compile','fib':fib,'capacities':[10**9]*8,'max_stride':32}
t=time.time(); out=pipeline.do_compile(req); t1=time.time()-t
print('native compile time %.2f s' % t1, out['status'], out.get('cuts'), out.get('used_bits'), out.get('peak'))
# image size
s=json_len=len(__import__('json').dumps(out))
print('image json bytes', s)
EOF
